entries.columnsContract: `commit_marker PK, effect_id, owner_domain, scope_type, scope_id, commit_digest, result_id FK, result_schema_ref, result_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `commit_marker`全局唯一；Event驱动的`domain_fact_commit|responsibility_control_commit`其result字段必填并与对应`fx_event_result_bindings`同事务写入；唯一例外是非Event的Procurement Run Admission，其result字段为NULL，完整`ProcurementControlReceipt`由同事务`fx_command_receipts`承载并以marker scope/digest交叉验证；不能更新或删除

entries.columnsContract: `message_id PK, producer_domain, message_kind, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_revision, dedup_key, consumer_set_digest, intended_consumer_count, payload_schema_ref, payload_json, payload_digest, state, available_at_ms, created_at_ms, all_acked_at_ms`
`message_id FK, consumer_domain, state(pending|delivered|acked), attempt_count, next_attempt_at_ms, acked_at_ms`
`event_id FK, resource_key, queue_class, local_priority, enqueued_at_ms, retry_at_ms, state`
`event_attempt_id FK, resource_key, queue_class, enqueued_at_ms, acquired_at_ms, released_at_ms, wait_duration_ms, hold_duration_ms, outcome`
`circuit_key PK, state, reason_code, evidence_digest, opened_at_ms, reviewed_at_ms`

`incident_key PK, owner_domain, process_type, work_kind, error_code, occurrence_count, circuit_key, incident_state(open|recovering|resolved), evidence_digest, first_seen_at_ms, last_seen_at_ms, resolved_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: Foundation-only lifecycle；`incident_key=SHA-256(JCS({owner_domain,process_type,work_kind,error_code,resource_scope_key?}))`，其中可选`resource_scope_key`不新增列，只能来自该Work实际冻结/使用的Permit、typed Resource Demand及`fx_event_resource_timings`并冻结在identity/circuit digest；无法精确归因时省略该值并保持process-local；同一terminal Work occurrence重复观察不增加计数，新的occurrence以CAS单调增加，达到3次时打开exact-scope Circuit；首个命中scope的新Work获得`open → recovering`资格，只有其实际成功经过的同一process/resource path invariant evidence才允许`recovering → resolved`并关闭对应Circuit；Domain只能读取Incident ref/projection，不得控制其生命周期；`INDEX(incident_state,last_seen_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `material_key PK, mount_scope_id, inode, size_bytes, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, owner_domain NULL, owner_scope_type NULL, owner_scope_id NULL, control_revision, state(controlled|released), updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(mount_scope_id,inode,size_bytes,fingerprint_algorithm,fingerprint_version,content_fingerprint)`；一项Identity只有一行current Control且Identity列write-once，Control row不得物理删除；controlled必须有完整owner，released必须三个owner列均NULL；首次acquire revision=1，transfer/release必须CAS并递增`control_revision`；从未存在row与released row都可投影uncontrolled，但revision分别为0和当前正整数

entries.columnsContract: `material_key FK, revision, operation_kind, from_owner_domain, from_scope_type, from_scope_id, to_owner_domain, to_scope_type, to_scope_id, basis_digest, commit_marker, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(material_key,revision)`；append-only；current row每次变化必须与对应revision同事务成立。任一正整数historical revision的post-state `MaterialControlProjectionSnapshot@1`必须仅由该revision row重建：`resultKind=available,controlRevision=revision`；to-owner完整则`controlState=controlled`并使用to scope，`regionProjection`按`procurement|libra|arca → procurement|production|finished_goods`映射；to-owner全NULL则`controlState=uncontrolled,regionProjection=uncontrolled`且无owner；`evidenceDigest/projectionDigest`严格使用8.6.18公式。不得读取后来current owner冒充historical post-state，也不新增projection JSON/digest列

entries.columnsContract: `workspace_id PK, owner_domain, process_type, process_id, root_handle_ref, state(active|reclaimed), created_at_ms, reclaim_after_ms NULL, reclaimed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(owner_domain,process_type,process_id,workspace_id)`；`rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`且只允许Workspace Admission插入active，随后由Owner Cleanup全部member completed事务以expected active CAS一次为reclaimed；active时reclaimed time为NULL，terminal时非NULL且不得恢复active；`INDEX(owner_domain,state,reclaim_after_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `workspace_id FK, material_handle_id, material_key, endpoint_id, mount_scope_id, inode, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, relative_path, digest_algorithm, digest_hex, size_bytes, reference_revision, owner_domain, process_id, root_handle_ref, access_scope, handle_schema_ref, handle_json, handle_digest, fence_digest, state(active|reclaimed), reclaimed_effect_id NULL, reclaimed_effect_receipt_digest NULL, reclaimed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(workspace_id,material_handle_id)`；`UNIQUE(workspace_id,relative_path)`；`rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`且只允许幂等filesystem cleanup effect以expected Handle fence执行一次`active→reclaimed`，三个reclaimed列在active时全NULL、terminal时全非NULL且write-once；`handle_schema_ref=WorkspaceMaterialHandle@1`、canonical JSON≤`4 KiB`、`handle_digest=SHA-256(JCS(handle_json typed value))`，全部热列与Handle逐字段一致，`fence_digest=handle_json.fenceDigest`；同一inode的hard-link location允许共享materialKey但必须是不同Handle/relative path；endpoint/mount/root handle必须等于Workspace Registry/root snapshot；完整Physical Identity由Workspace write effect在同一Effect commit按实际文件stat与中段最多256 KiB fingerprint形成，系统生成Artifact的完整digest只允许从原写入流形成且不参与`material_key`；路径必须通过containment validator；只有bytes关闭、fingerprint/stat/containment及独立Artifact digest完成且完整Handle row与Effect receipt同事务durable后Executor才能返回该Handle。Domain Cleanup Commit只读取该terminal row/Evidence并收口Libra Reference/Control，不再次删除bytes或改写本row
